author: National Geographic
description:
Join National Geographic in AlUla, an ancient Arabian oasis city in Saudi Arabia that is home to a wealth of historical heritage and unsolved mysteries. One of the most fascinating aspects of this city is the ancient city of Dadan, which dates back to the 9th century BCE. Why did the kingdom of Dadan suddenly disappear? The team applies the research of archaeologists and historians to reveal the secrets of the ancient civilizations, exquisite natural assets, and immense legacy of art of this area that continues to inspire generations.
